title: Edit code containing regex or escapes with the Edit tool, not generated JS strings
trigger: when changing source that contains regular expressions, backslash escapes or newline literals through a node -e or heredoc script
behavior_delta: Use the Edit tool for any replacement whose new text contains backslashes (regex classes like \s, \n literals, Windows paths). String-replacement scripts written in heredocs and template literals drop one level of escaping silently, and CRLF files make exact-match replacements fail.
what: Use the Edit tool for any replacement whose new text contains backslashes (regex classes like \s, \n literals, Windows paths). String-replacement scripts written in heredocs and template literals drop one level of escaping silently, and CRLF files make exact-match replacements fail.
why: On 2026-09-22 a heredoc-generated edit turned /\s+/ into /s+/ in src/engine/retrieve.js, so injected headlines lost every letter s, and several scripted edits failed on '\n\n' and CRLF mismatches.

evidence_refs.summary: headline() regexes that were corrupted and then fixed
